narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green: `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. It only broke on rows where both discount and tax were non-zero, so most cases masked it.

Now it discounts first, then taxes that result. Nothing else to do.
